_note: Tradition-neutral observation features. The observation layer records only these IDs; each tradition supplies its own name for a feature. Labels marked provisional await source confirmation. CC BY-SA 4.0.

observability_classes.scan_only: assessable only from a flatbed scan
observability_classes.wrist_required: assessable only when the wrist crease is in frame and uncovered
observability_classes.lighting_dependent: not assessed in the MVP: depends on lighting
observability_classes.postponed: not assessed in the MVP (mounts, minor markings, symbols)
observability_classes.not_image_assessable: needs touch or 3-D information; never assessed
observability_classes.excluded: must never be observed or used (e.g. skin colour)
